description: Agent Pre-Sign Risk Report (ERC draft, ethereum/ERCs PR #2134): send a PresignRequest {version: "erc-presign/1", subject: {type: "calls", chainId: "eip155:4663", from: "eip155:4663:0x...", calls: [{to, value, data}], typedData?, authorizationList?}, context?: {payment?, texts?, tokens?}} and get a PresignReport: typed facts about the unsigned request on Robinhood Chain, each read or not read at one pinned block (approval amount, unlimited, share of supply, expiry, current allowance; address code; issuer listing of stock tokens; ERC-8470 launch observations; ERC-8478 payee binding; control characters, mixed scripts, addresses and injection classes (from our published pattern set) in text), bound to the request by digest and EIP-712 signed by Toll (ERC-8004 agent #20030). No verdict: apply your own policy, and treat not read as unknown, never as clean. Toll's ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK pre-sign answer carries this same report.

context.description: Optional: {payment: {requirements (the x402 accepts entry chosen), resource?, payee?: {registry, agentId}}, texts: [{field, ref?, text}], tokens: [CAIP-10]}

kinds.description: Optional: only these finding kinds, each a name or {kind, param}; an optional kind named here is reported for every entity it applies to, read or not read

subject.description: {type: "calls", chainId: "eip155:4663", from: "eip155:4663:0x<signer>", calls: [{to, value (wei, decimal string), data}], typedData?, authorizationList? (EIP-7702: bound into the subject digest; each authority listed, its code after the list not read)}, or {type: "prepared-tx-envelope", envelope} (an evm-tx, evm-batch or eip-712 signature envelope with content.from; the subject digest is the envelope without risk and producer.signature)

name: presign_risk_report
title: Pre-sign risk report
